quote: The Side Letter provides that **Delaware law** governs and the **Delaware Court of Chancery** has exclusive jurisdiction for "all claims, disputes and causes of action arising out of or relating to indemnification under the Purchase Agreement or this Letter Agreement" (§ 6.1–6.2). Because the Side Letter has first priority (§ 11.11), indemnification claims are governed by Delaware law and must be brought in Delaware, while all other claims ... are governed by New York law and must be brought in New York.
reason: Issue 4 identifies the right documents and provisions: Side Letter §6 (Delaware law and Chancery) against SPA §§11.8–11.9 (New York). It explains that the §11.11 precedence clause lets the Side Letter control, and that this splits forum and law for indemnity claims, with the risk of inconsistent outcomes. It also recommends conforming the Side Letter to New York.
